newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope, Castro to meet on Tuesday - Vatican.
newsitem.headline: Pope, Castro to meet on Tuesday - Vatican.

text.p: Pope John Paul will hold an historic private audience with Cuban President Fidel Castro at the Vatican on Tuesday, the Vatican said on Saturday.
Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls said the audience, the first meeting between the two men, would take place at the Vatican at 1000 GMT on Tuesday.
The encounter between the leader of the world's some 960 million Roman Catholics and the veteran communist leader is expected to pave the way for the Pope's first trip to the Caribbean island.
Predominantly Catholic Cuba, whose government has had sometimes frosty relations with the local Church, is the only Spanish-speaking Latin American country the 76-year-old Pope has not visited.
Castro, who is attending the U.N.-sponsored World Food Summit, arrived in Rome earlier on Saturday.
